placeholder6Dof.name: Primitive training manipulator
placeholder6Dof.notice: A training stand-in, not a PROMPOWER model. Its geometry and joint limits are invented and will be replaced once the real URDF arrives.

course.lastLesson: This is the last lesson of the course

teach.title: Teach the robot a point

hint.ok: Drag the sliders — the grey copy shows where the robot will go.
hint.clamped: The stored angles are past the robot's limits: the copy stands at the closest pose it can reach.
hint.unreachable: The stored point is out of reach: the copy starts from the current pose.
hint.blocked: Out of reach: the step was not applied, the copy stayed put.

teach.alignDownNote: A training button. On an industrial pendant you set orientation by hand or through a coordinate system.

desktopOnly.title: The task opens on a computer or tablet
desktopOnly.text: The task runs in a 3D scene: the robot, the controls and the checks do not fit a phone screen. Read the theory here and open this address on a computer for the task.

jog.title: Joints
